newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to hire more new grads in April '98.
newsitem.headline: Honda to hire more new grads in April '98.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Friday that it was planning to hire a total of 700 new high school and college graduates in April 1998, the first increase in three years.
The car maker will hire 435 new graduates in April 1997, a Honda official told reporters.
"We have decided to increase the number of people we hire in April in order to strengthen our production and development divisions," he said.
The 700 will comprise 400 university graduates and 300 high school graduates, he said.
For the last several years, Honda has reduced its workforce by cutting the number of its new recruits and by not replacing workers who retired as part of its cost-cutting programme.

Japanese companies generally hire new graduates in April but a growing number of them also hire people who have work experience in other companies throughout the year when they need additional labour.
